application_conditions: In-app referral code for existing Plasma One account holders with an active card in good standing; no publisher or affiliate programme found on plasma.org or the help centre.
paid_action: Qualifying referral (Addendum §5, read 2026-11-24) = registers with the Referral Code, never held a Plasma One account, completes identity verification, activates a Card. The earlier wording 'and an eligible purchase made' is no longer in the definition (the earning window still only pays on eligible spend). Then: referral cashback on the friend's spend, plus one-time spend bonuses and upgrade bonuses.
validation_conditions: Earning window 'runs from registration' and is 'fixed at the Referred User's registration' (Addendum, 2026-11-24 read; the help-centre article read on 2026-11-03 said it starts when the friend redeems the code). Lengths per the help centre (2026-11-03): Lite and Core 3 months, Platinum 6 months. 'Applicable limits' apply, amounts not published. Users in excluded countries (list in the Help Center, not read) are not eligible for spend bonuses. No Upgrade Bonus for a Platinum unlock, or for a Core unlock made by locking XPL, where referrer or referred user is a UK resident.

commission.model_note: Referral cashback by the referrer's tier: Lite 0.25%, Core 1%, Platinum 1% of the referred user's eligible card spend (compare page 2026-11-24: 'Referral cashback 0.25% / 1% / 1%' under the marketing names Standard / Premium / Platinum). Addendum §5: paid in XPL 'in accordance with Section 7'; §7 lets Plasma pay in XPL or Spending Credit at its election. One-time spend bonuses (first-spend, high-spend) and Core/Platinum upgrade bonuses paid as Spending Credit; amounts 'in the Help Center' except the Platinum upgrade bonus stated as $300 in spend credit (help centre, 2026-11-03). Second-degree rewards: 'earned one level removed only'.
commission.tiers_note: Lite rate recorded as the base. Naming mismatch since at least 2026-11-24: the Addendum (§2) names the tiers Lite / Core / Platinum while plasma.org/personal and /compare market them as Standard (free) / Premium ($600/yr) / Platinum ($2,500/yr). The Platinum article still shows a 3% 'Platinum Referral Cashback Boost' (90 days or $300) that the referral article (2026-09-23) and the Addendum (2026-09-26, legacy page plasma.org/platinum-referral-rewards) say is replaced by the $300 upgrade bonus for registrations on or after 2026-09-26.

payout.method: Referral cashback in XPL to the Plasma One account; bonuses as revocable Spending Credit (no cash value, cannot be withdrawn or converted, forfeited on account closure)
payout.frequency: Weekly (currently Thursdays), after a pending period of several days

rules_note: Governed by the Plasma One Rewards Addendum (effective 2026-09-26; now served at plasma.org/plasma-one-rewards — the former URL /plasma-one-cashback-and-referral-terms could not be fetched on 2026-11-24, redirect not confirmed) and the Terms of Service (arbitration, class-action waiver). Programs may be modified or terminated prospectively. Operator Plasma states it is 'not a regulated financial institution'; card issued by Rain, accounts by Bridge entities. UK users: additional disclaimers at plasma.org/uk-disclaimer. Addendum §8 (re-read 2026-11-24) prohibits '(ix) self-referral', '(x) promoting Referral Codes through unauthorized paid ads or spam', '(xi) buying or selling Referral Codes or Rewards'; no restriction on organic website publication. 'Codes distributed by Plasma directly have no Referrer.' Code RPQNUY supplied by David (account holder) on 2026-11-07. Use on the website only — no paid ads, no spam.
allowed_countries_note: Must reside where the Programs are available; excluded countries for spend bonuses are listed in the Help Center (not read). UK residents excluded from Platinum and XPL-lock Core upgrade bonuses.
